body.query: union (SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated>ago(7d) | summarize v=dcount(IncidentNumber) | extend metric='total'),(SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated>ago(7d) | where Title has 'Golden Ticket' | summarize v=dcount(IncidentNumber) | extend metric='gt'),(SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated>ago(7d) | where Title has 'SIDHistory' | summarize v=dcount(IncidentNumber) | extend metric='sid'),(SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated>ago(7d) | where Title has 'Volatility' | summarize v=dcount(IncidentNumber) | extend metric='mem_inc'),(VolatilityAnalysis_CL | where TimeGenerated>ago(7d) and riskLevel_s=='CRITICAL' | summarize v=count() | extend metric='mem_crit'),(SecurityEvent | where TimeGenerated>ago(24h) | where EventID==4769 | summarize v=count() | extend metric='e4769'),(SecurityEvent | where TimeGenerated>ago(24h) | where EventID==4768 | summarize v=count() | extend metric='e4768'),(SecurityEvent | where TimeGenerated>ago(24h) | where EventID==4662 | summarize v=count() | extend metric='e4662') | project metric, v
